items: EXCITING GAMEPLAY - Indulge in endless family fun and friendly competition with our Unicorn Claw Machine! Watch your child's eyes light up with excitement as they control the claw, aiming to grab adorable prizes. It's a thrilling experience that keeps kids engaged for hours of fun

WHIMSICAL UNICORN DESIGN - This candy grabber claw machine combines classic arcade fun with vibrant colors and a charming unicorn motif, creating an instant attraction for kids who love all things magical. Featuring cheerful carnival music and a 60-second time limit, creating a lively atmosphere and adding challenge to the game

SKILL AND PRECISION - Exercise children's hand-eye coordination as they learn to master the art of maneuvering the claw. Every successful grab is a triumph, boosting their confidence and sense of achievement. Encourages problem-solving skills, patience, concentration, and strategic thinking

VARIETY OF PRIZES - This kid's mini claw machine comes with 20 random mini plushies. You can fill the machine with whatever prizes you like, such as small toys, trinkets, wrapped candies, snacks, or small treats. Imagine the excitement as kids try to grab their favorite treats, making each game not only fun but also rewarding

SAFE & EASY TO USE - Designed with smooth edges and durable materials to withstand enthusiastic play, suitable for kids of all ages. To get started, turn the switch ON, then move the joystick 360° to catch the selected prize. Say goodbye to dead battery with the flexibility of USB and battery options. Whether at home or on-the-go, the fun never stops

PERFECT FOR PARTIES AND EVENTS - Make birthdays, playdates, and family gatherings extra special with the mini vending machine. The excitement of playing, the joy of winning, and the laughter shared with friends and family become cherished moments your child will fondly remember. Great gift for kids ages 3 4 5 6 7 8 years old
